sources.title: Large Language Models Hallucination: A Comprehensive Survey
sources.snippet: Model-centric training and adaptation-based approaches involve modifying architectures, adjusting training objectives, and employing fine-tuning procedures to improve models' intrinsic factuality and reliability. Based on our analysis, we show that no single approach completely mitigates hallucination.
